Cc: platform-ops@cloudwave.io
Date: 2026-11-25T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood architecture deep-dive — confirm 11/29 10:00 PST

Hi Vanessa / Marcus,

Thanks again for offering an architecture review. The product team is hoping for a focused 45–60 minute session next Monday (11/29) at 10:00 AM PST to walk through:
- our current prefix caching approach and how Redwood's KV cache can map to it
- VPC peering / private deployment options and egress patterns
- an example rollout strategy with canary traffic split

Attendees on our side: myself (platform lead), plus our infra engineer (platform-ops@cloudwave.io).

If that slot works we can keep it tight — agenda attached. If not, happy to move.

Best,
Alex Chen
Platform Lead, Cloudwave
alex.chen@cloudwave.io

Hi Alex — we started the call at 10:00 and waited ~10 minutes but didn't see any external attendees. Marcus and I are online and ready. If something came up on your end, no problem — we can reschedule or run a short ad-hoc office hours slot.

Quick options:
- today 11/29 at 11:00–11:30 PST (we can keep it to caching + peering)
- tomorrow 11/30 at 09:00–10:00 PST (longer, can include rollout strategy)
- Dec 2 between 10:00–12:00 (block for overlap/office hours)

If those don't suit you, please propose two windows and we'll confirm. I've attached a pared-down agenda and an updated infra diagram we planned to share.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the flexibility — Alex
